detail.longDescription: It bugged me recently that the New York City subway countdown clocks show an estimated time that is often inaccurate. Since many of the delays are due to other trains on the same track, I figured: why not just show the trains? Source code: https://github.com/fatlotus/mta-dot-rip/ . Disclaimer: This project was written with AI. The code is very hacky, I wouldn't use it for learning if you're just getting started with Go or JavaScript.
